    12  # Eventual sign of polynomials
    13  
    14  This file proves that a polynomial has a fixed sign beyond its largest or smallest root.
    15  
    16  ## Main statements
    17  
    18  * `zero_lt_eval_of_roots_lt_of_leadingCoeff_nonneg`:
    19    If `x` is larger than all roots of `P` and the leading coefficient of `P` is nonnegative
    20    then `P (x)` is positive.
    21  * `zero_le_eval_of_roots_le_of_leadingCoeff_nonneg`:
    22    If we only assume that `x` is at least as large as all roots, then `P (x)` is nonnegative.

    29    `negOnePow_mul_eval_le_zero_of_le_roots_of_leadingCoeff_nonpos`:
    30    Analogous results for `x` which is smaller than (or at least as small as) all roots.

    47  theorem zero_lt_eval_of_roots_lt_of_leadingCoeff_nonneg
    48      (hroots : ∀ y, P.IsRoot y → y < x) (hlc : 0 ≤ P.leadingCoeff) : 0 < P.eval x := by
    49    replace hlc : 0 < P.leadingCoeff := by
    50      contrapose! hroots
    51      exact ⟨x, by simp [leadingCoeff_eq_zero.mp <| eq_of_le_of_ge hroots hlc], le_refl x⟩
    52    by_cases! hdeg : P.degree ≤ 0
    53    · rwa [eq_C_of_degree_le_zero hdeg, ← natDegree_eq_zero_iff_degree_le_zero.mpr hdeg, eval_C]
    54    contrapose! hroots
    55    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Filter.Eventually.exists_forall_of_atTop <|
    56      (P.tendsto_atTop_of_leadingCoeff_nonneg hdeg hlc.le).eventually_gt_atTop 0
    57    let w := max x z
    58    have hw : x ≤ w ∧ 0 < P.eval w := ⟨le_max_left .., hz w (le_max_right ..)⟩
    59    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := (Set.mem_image ..).mp
    60      (intermediate_value_Icc hw.1 P.continuous.continuousOn (show 0 ∈ _ by grind))
    61    exact ⟨y, ⟨hy.2, by grind⟩⟩

    64      (hroots : ∀ y, P.IsRoot y → y ≤ x) (hlc : 0 ≤ P.leadingCoeff) : 0 ≤ P.eval x := by
